<!-- architectural-pr-review-finding -->
**Medium — Production image build now depends on CI-only helpers and source resolution** `architecture`

The example-backend Dockerfile now runs a script from `scripts/ci/`. That script exports the admin SPA with `TERRENO_METRO_FROM_SOURCE=1`, so the `/console` bundle that ships is built from `src` instead of the `dist` exports consumers get. The three app `metro.config.js` files also now `require` a module under `scripts/ci/`, so app build config depends on a CI script directory.

**Recommendation:** Move the Metro helper and the Docker compile script into a non-CI location such as `scripts/build/` or a shared metro-config module, and keep the production admin-spa export on the `dist` resolution path unless shipping a source-resolved bundle is intended and documented.

**References:**
- [`example-backend/Dockerfile:12-15`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/example-backend/Dockerfile#L12-L15) — `RUN sh scripts/ci/docker-compile-and-export.sh` replaces the inline compile and export steps in the production image build.
- [`scripts/ci/docker-compile-and-export.sh:29-31`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/scripts/ci/docker-compile-and-export.sh#L29-L31) — The production admin-spa export runs with `TERRENO_METRO_FROM_SOURCE=1` while compile runs in parallel.
- [`admin-spa/metro.config.js:4`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/admin-spa/metro.config.js#L4) — The app Metro config requires `../scripts/ci/metroFromSource`. `demo/metro.config.js` and `example-frontend/metro.config.js` do the same.

<!-- architectural-pr-review-finding -->
**Medium — Smoke and e2e bundles no longer exercise package dist exports** `testing`

With `TERRENO_METRO_FROM_SOURCE=1`, the smoke exports, the e2e-prepare export, the admin-spa e2e build, and the Maestro export all resolve `@terreno/*` to `src`. A broken `exports` map or a compile-output regression in the frontend packages would no longer be caught by any web smoke or e2e run.

**Recommendation:** Keep at least one web export (for example the `smoke-export-example-frontend` job, or a nightly job) on the default dist resolution so the published package entry points are still covered.

**References:**
- [`.circleci/continue-config.yml:1403-1416`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/.circleci/continue-config.yml#L1403-L1416) — The `smoke-export` jobs set `TERRENO_METRO_FROM_SOURCE: "1"` for every smoke web build.
- [`.circleci/continue-config.yml:1997-2010`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/.circleci/continue-config.yml#L1997-L2010) — `e2e-prepare` exports the Playwright web bundle from source in parallel with compile.
- [`scripts/ci/metroFromSource.js:49-65`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/scripts/ci/metroFromSource.js#L49-L65) — The resolver rewrites `dist/*.js` export targets to `src/*.{ts,tsx}`, which bypasses the built package output.

<!-- architectural-pr-review-finding -->
**Medium — Splitting the app shard narrowed the affected-gate routes for settings** `operability`

The old `app` shard was triggered by `${APP}/settings/**`. The new shards only list `${APP}/settings/mcp/**`, so changes to other settings routes no longer reach any app shard through the affected gate.

**Recommendation:** Add `${APP}/settings/**` (minus the mcp subtree, if it should stay with app-ai) to `app-shell` so the split keeps the same route coverage as the old shard.

**References:**
- [`scripts/ci/e2eAffected/shards.ts:72-94`](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/blob/faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f/scripts/ci/e2eAffected/shards.ts#L72-L94) — The `settings/**` route was removed. Only `app-ai` lists `settings/mcp/**`, and `app-shell` has no settings route.

## CodeQL / Incomplete string escaping or encoding

This replaces only the first occurrence of "*".

[Show more details](https://github.com/TerrenoLabs/terreno/security/code-scanning/341)

### Smoke archive omits admin-spa plugin **High Severity** `smoke-compile` excludes every `admin-spa` `dist` tree from `smoke-dists.tgz`, including `admin-spa/src/dist`. That is the compiled `AdminSpaServeApp` plugin (`exports` point at `./src/dist/index.js`). The later `smoke` job never recompiles, so `import("@terreno/admin-spa")` in the admin-spa smoke cannot resolve and the workspace smoke job fails.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit faacbd85bf8c3fd0d6cc9292ef622cbf3f68f33f. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
